explanation: The dirty-set compile is guarded differently. The original tests the engine-set pointer for null before reading its dirty byte (+112) and calling compile (recovered/native/hexrays-all/chunk_016.c:366), so an entry whose m_animSet is null is skipped; the reconstruction dereferences set.m_animSet unconditionally. Every path that registers a set calls CreateAnimSet (0x47653c, 0x476398), so this is a robustness gap rather than a reachable crash today: severity low. The same pattern appears in GetAnimator (chunk_016.c:404) and is not reported twice.
